links.outcome: Patient trust and adherence intention with teledermatologist-supervised AI advice versus AI-only advice in vignette app scenarios
links.effect: Trust higher with hybrid advice (mean 76.9 vs 65.7; difference 11.98; P<.001). Adherence odds 1.7 times greater with hybrid vs AI-only (95% CI 1.28-2.22). Effect on adherence fully mediated by trust.
links.quote: Teledermatologist supervision of AI-based advice robustly increased patient trust and adherence intentions, particularly for high-risk assessments and concerned users.

models_evaluated: AI-driven skin cancer mobile health app
unlisted_practices: Teledermatologist supervision of AI-based skin cancer app advice to increase patient trust and adherence intentions
